thread:
anya: quick canary update for quant8-chat-v2 — running at 10% on staging->prod route. rough numbers from last 2h:

sam: p50 latency +6ms, p99 +40ms, token-cost -22% :money_with_wings:

jia: eval on seed-set shows instr-qa EM down 0.9% vs baseline (control is fp16). hallucination_rate +0.7% (per our taxonomy)

matt: that's within noise? what's CI? :thinking:

anya: bootstrap 95% CI on EM diff is +/-0.4%, so 0.9% is marginally significant. also seeing uptick on short-answer fidelity slices.

kevin: what do we anchor thresholds to? we should tie fallback to control-group delta not absolute. recommend: auto-fallback when EM_delta <= -1.2% and hallucination_delta >= +1.0% over a 30m rolling window.

olivia: +1. We should also require latency_p99 not > baseline_p99 + 60ms else skip promote.

sam: here's current metrics snapshot:

```
control(fp16): EM=78.6, halluc=2.1, latency_p99=420
variant(quant8): EM=77.7, halluc=2.8, latency_p99=460
```

jia: slice breakdown: short-form answers EM delta -2.4%, long-form 0.1%. worrying on prompts with numeric reasoning.

ops-bot: deploy 1764321987 by anya -> canary started at 10% traffic to prod (pool: chat-prod-us)

matt: given that, proposed action: reduce traffic to 5%, enable auto-fallback, kick off contrastive eval on 5k seed prompts. thoughts?

anya: agree. also toggle smoothing window to 15m to react faster for hallucination bursts.

kevin: slight caution — 15m can cause oscillation. suggest min-hold 10m after fallback before re-promote.

olivia: I'll update rollout config. snippet:

```
"rollout": {
  "initial_traffic": 0.10,
  "min_traffic": 0.05,
  "auto_fallback": {
    "trk_metric": "instr_qa_em",
    "delta_threshold": -1.2,
    "alt_metric": "hallucination_rate",
    "alt_threshold": 1.0,
    "window_minutes": 30,
    "smoothing_minutes": 15,
    "min_hold_minutes": 10
  }
}
```

sam: ping on dashboards PR to expose slice-level deltas and CI bands. need that before we change min_traffic.

anya: opened ticket: #ML-823. will reduce to 5% now, enable fallback per above, and run the 5k eval. i'll post results in 30m.

olivia: :thumbsup:

matt: thanks — if variant stays degraded after 2h we auto-rollback to fp16 and open postmortem.

anya: noted. I'll also attach the seed prompts to the ticket.

ops-bot: canary traffic reduced to 5% (action by olivia) — status ok

kevin: one more ask — add a control anchor metric: semantic_sim_drop (cosine) so we don't tune only for EM.

anya: added to ticket. thx.

jia: will run the contrastive eval and report top 3 failure modes.

anya: closing loop for now. thanks all.
